thread:
tom: FYI partner EdgeBox flagged customers seeing wrong tiered discounts in Marketplace invoices after last week's ratecard change.

partner-edgebox: hi, we noticed several customers billed at the wrong SLA tier (bronze vs silver). we send per-device minute usage; marketplace applies tiering at hourly bucket.

erin: can you paste one example customer rows?

partner-edgebox: sample (sanitized): device=A1, 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z, units=2; device=A1, 2026-03-21T14:58:00Z, units=50. Partner aggregated locally to minute then charged per-customer daily.

vik: sounds like an edge case: our tiering logic computes tier based on total units per hour per customer SKU, but partner applies customer-level daily discounts before sending. mismatch of pre-aggregation window leads to different tier boundaries.

tom: oh: partner sends raw minute events but also submits a daily "discount snapshot" file with their own computed tier. our ingestion currently ignores partner discount snapshots for marketplace billing decisions.

billing-bot: created PARTNER-3601: "EdgeBox discount snapshot vs marketplace tiering mismatch" assigned to erin. https://redwood.internal/partners/3601

erin: mitigation options: 1) apply tiering on our side strictly from raw events (current); 2) accept partner snapshot and trust their tiering when signed and accompanied by per-hour rollups and checksum; 3) compute both and surface discrepancy to customer as "partner vs marketplace tiering" line item.

finance: customer impact: if marketplace billed higher tier than partner snapshot, customers expect credit. prefer deterministic rule so partners know how to prepare.

partner-edgebox: preference is option 2 — they already calculate best-effort discounts per customer and want that honored, but will sign snapshots and include per-hour hashes. we can add header X-Partner-Signed and manifest with hour-level checksums.

vik: technical constraints: honoring partner snapshots means we must trust integrity (signed manifest) and ensure idempotency. also need to reconcile when our raw recomputed tier differs. propose flow: on ingest, if signed snapshot present and valid, write a preaggregated_tier record and mark billing pipeline to use partner_tier_preference for that billing cycle. otherwise fallback to recomputed tier.

tom: add reconciliation: nightly job compares partner_snapshot_hourly vs recomputed_hourly; if difference, auto-create a "tier-discrepancy" ticket for manual review when delta > 5% or delta causes tier shift.

erin: tests: add integration case where partner snapshot downgrades hour from silver->bronze and ensure invoice uses partner tier when signed. place test in integration/partners/edgebox/partner-snapshot.spec.ts.

billing-bot: noted: update partner onboarding to require hour-level checksums and RSA signature for snapshot acceptance. PARTNER-3601 updated.

finance: also flag policy: credits generated by partner-signed snapshots will show as "partner discount adj" on next invoice. need legal ok.

partner-edgebox: we'll add signed manifests and switch to hour-level rollups by Wed. thanks.

vik: follow-ups: 1) implement signed-snapshot acceptance, 2) reconciliation job, 3) monitoring alert on tier-discrepancy >5%. I'll own 1+2.

erin: I'll draft partner playbook language and get legal looped for credit policy.

tom: scheduled sync Fri 11am PT to confirm prod rollout. :calendar:
